name: Stump
description: Stump is a free and open-source comics, manga and digital book server. It organizes CBZ, CBR, EPUB and PDF files into libraries and series, reads them in the browser with progress tracking, and serves them to OPDS readers and the Stump mobile apps.

notes.text: There is no default login: the first account created in the onboarding becomes the owner. Anyone who reaches the port can claim the server until then, so do it right after the install.
Create a library pointing at /opt/stump_data/library. To use a host folder, mount it there with pct set <CTID> -mp0 /path/on/host,mp=/opt/stump_data/library.
OPDS readers connect to http://<IP>:10801/opds/v1.2/catalog (or /opds/v2.0/catalog) with a Stump username and password.
